1: // Simple Space Debris Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
10: 
11:   // ----- Player -----
12:   const player = {
13:     x: width / 2,
14:     y: height - 40,
15:     size: 20,
16:     angle: 0, // radians
17:     speed: 0,
18:     maxSpeed: 4,
19:     thrust: 0.1,
20:     friction: 0.98,
21:     draw() {
22:       ctx.save();
23:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
24:       ctx.rotate(this.angle);
25:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
26:       ctx.beginPath();
27:       ctx.moveTo(0, -this.size / 2);
28:       ctx.lineTo(this.size / 2, this.size / 2);
29:       ctx.lineTo(-this.size / 2, this.size / 2);
30:       ctx.closePath();
31:       ctx.fill();
32:       ctx.restore();
33:     },
34:     update() {
35:       this.x += Math.cos(this.angle) * this.speed;
36:       this.y += Math.sin(this.angle) * this.speed;
37:       this.speed *= this.friction;
38:       // Keep inside canvas
39:       if (this.x < 0) this.x = width;
40:       if (this.x > width) this.x = 0;
41:       if (this.y < 0) this.y = height;
42:       if (this.y > height) this.y = 0;
43:     }
44:   };
45: 
46:   // ----- Asteroids -----
47:   const asteroids = [];
48:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
49:   let lastSpawn = 0;
50: 
51:   function spawnAsteroid() {
52:     const size = 15 + Math.random() * 25;
53:     const x = Math.random() * width;
54:     const y = -size;
55:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
56:     asteroids.push({ x, y, size, speed });
57:   }
58: 
59:   function updateAsteroids(dt) {
60:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
61:       const a = asteroids[i];
62:       a.y += a.speed;
63:       if (a.y - a.size > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
64:     }
65:   }
66: 
67:   function drawAsteroids() {
68:     ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
69:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
70:       ctx.beginPath();
71:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
72:       ctx.fill();
73:     });
74:   }
75: 
76:   // ----- Input -----
77:   const keys = {};
78:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
79:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
80: 
81:   function handleInput() {
82:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.angle -= 0.07;
83:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.angle += 0.07;
84:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) {
85:       player.speed = Math.min(player.maxSpeed, player.speed + player.thrust);
86:     }
87:   }
88: 
89:   // ----- Collision -----
90:   function checkCollision() {
91:     for (const a of asteroids) {
92:       const dx = a.x - player.x;
93:       const dy = a.y - player.y;
94:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
95:       if (dist < a.size + player.size / 2) return true;
96:     }
97:     return false;
98:   }
99: 
100:   // ----- Game Loop -----
101:   let lastTime = performance.now();
102:   let running = true;
103:   let score = 0;
104: 
105:   function loop(now) {
106:     const dt = now - lastTime;
107:     lastTime = now;
108: 
109:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
110: 
111:     // spawn
112:     if (now - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
113:       spawnAsteroid();
114:       lastSpawn = now;
115:     }
116: 
117:     handleInput();
118:     player.update();
119:     updateAsteroids(dt);
120:     player.draw();
121:     drawAsteroids();
122: 
123:     // score
124:     score += dt * 0.01;
125:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
126:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
127:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
128: 
129:     if (checkCollision()) {
130:       running = false;
131:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
132:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
133:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 80, height / 2);
134:       return;
135:     }
136: 
137:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
138:   }
139: 
140:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
141: })();
